# Bash4LLM⁺

> Zero-dependency POSIX Bash framework for secure, low-latency Large Language Model (LLM) inference, SSE streaming, persistent thread contexts, and OpenSSL AES-256 encrypted key management.

Operating strictly on standard POSIX base system utilities, `curl`, and `jq`, Bash4LLM⁺ eliminates external language runtimes (no Python, Node.js, Docker, or pip/npm modules).

## Core Documentation & Specifications

- [Architecture Specification (Canonical - EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/docs/bash4llm-arch-spec-en.md): Primary system architecture, bootstrap pipeline, and execution constraints.
- [Architecture Specification (Italian Translation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/docs/bash4llm-arch-spec.md): Technical specification of the internal engine in Italian.
- [Timeless Architecture Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/docs/timeless/timeless-arc-spec.md): Immutable architectural invariants and negative security constraints.
- [Timeless Testing Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/docs/timeless/timeless-test-spec.md): QA testing standards, compliance requirements, and execution rules.

## Security & Vault Infrastructure

- [Security Specification (Canonical - EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/SECURITY-en.md): Threat model, security guarantees, token redaction, and vulnerability boundaries.
- [Security Specification (Italian Translation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/SECURITY.md): Security policy specification in Italian.
- [OpenSSL Encrypted Vault Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/security/OPENSSL-HELPER.md): OpenSSL AES-256-CBC PBKDF2 vault operations and RAM context unlocking.

## Providers & Extensions

- [LLM Providers Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/PROVIDERS.md): Provider API contracts, trust domains, and module verification for Groq, Gemini, Mistral, and Hugging Face.
- [Hugging Face Module Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/providers/huggingface.md): Module configuration and payload mapping for Hugging Face API.

## Session Engine & Interactive TUI

- [Interactive TUI REPL Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/chat/SPEC-TUI.md): Protocol and UI design specification for `extras/chat/tui-repl.sh`.
- [Session Context Engine Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/session/README.md): Multi-turn session persistence, NDJSON history formats, and `SAFE_THREAD_ID` hashing.

## QA & Test Suite
